name: comment at end of input
reason: The GROQ specification ends a comment at a line feed or at the end of input; groq-js requires the line feed

name: space before a call's parenthesis
reason: The specification allows whitespace between tokens; groq-js requires the parenthesis to follow the name

name: space before a call's parenthesis with a string argument
reason: The specification allows whitespace between tokens; groq-js requires the parenthesis to follow the name

name: braced astral escape
reason: groq-js decodes braced escapes with String.fromCharCode, truncating astral code points; the compiler keeps the spelling, so both texts still mean the same to groq-js

name: unknown escape
reason: The specification has no \q escape; groq-js accepts any escape character and decodes unknown ones as the text "undefined"

name: pipe without a call
reason: groq-js skips `| name` when no parenthesis follows and returns the left-hand side; the compiler rejects it and compile falls back to the minified query, which groq-js reads the same way
